literal_meaning: onomatopoeic expression mimicking hurried, flustered movements (হাঁকু-পাঁকু: ব্যস্ততার অনুকরণ)
figurative_meaning_en: excessive busyness; breathless state caused by anxiety or flurry
similar_in_english: running around like a headless chicken
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার আগে ছাত্ররা হাঁকুপাঁকু করে উঠল।
অফিসে হঠাৎ কাজের চাপে সবাই হাঁকুপাঁকু করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The students got into a flap just before the exam.
Everyone in the office is in a tizzy due to the sudden workload.
note: This idiom is a reduplicative form typical in Bengali for expressing chaotic haste, deeply embedded in colloquial speech.
